name: Fable 5.1 Oracle
tagline: Thinks the build through and checks the work, but never writes the code itself
description: This one holds the thinking end of a coding setup and is deliberately kept off the keyboard. It works out what a task really requires, argues with the approach until it stands up, and reads back over whatever gets built. Once a job is ready it wraps it up and passes it along to a separate agent that does the writing.
author: bossriceshark
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
